children: Choice Institutional Equities's report on Capri Global Capital

CGCL Q2FY27 performance was driven by higher NII and PPoP. Total AUM grew by 62.3% YoY / 9.4% QoQ. Gold Loans AUM expanded by 101.8% YoY / 9.5% QoQ to INR 210.0 Bn, while the Housing Finance and Construction Finance increased by 39.4% YoY (+6.5% QoQ) to INR 83.3 Bn and 51.0% YoY (+18.5% QoQ) to INR 75.0 Bn, respectively. View and Valuation: We revise our FY27E/FY28E PAT estimate by +1.8%/ +2.1%, respectively, driven by stronger NII and AUM growth. We anticipate consolidated AUM to reach INR 660.2 Bn by FY28E.
We value CGCL using residual income approach at INR 320.0 and retain our ‘BUY’ rating on the stock. Our target price indicates FY27E/FY28E Price to Adjusted Book Value of 3.6x/2.9x.
